jensen.prompt:
A sprite sheet of SAME Jensen Huang caricature: silver hair, black glasses, black leather jacket, green GPU in right hand. Exactly six left-facing full-body poses, 3columns 2rows.
DRAW TWO DIFFERENT LEG ORDERS. In top row, the closer light-grey trouser leg is in FRONT to image LEFT, and distant dark-black leg trails to image RIGHT. In BOTTOM ROW, the closer light-grey trouser leg is BEHIND to image RIGHT, and distant dark-black leg leads to image LEFT. This means for BOTTOM ROW, draw the diagonal crotch separation line like '/' instead of '\'. The near thigh covers the distant thigh at the hip while pointing DOWN RIGHT and the far thigh emerges from behind pointing DOWN LEFT. The shoe of the LIGHTER near leg must be on the RIGHT half in bottom-left and bottom-middle, while the shoe of DARKER far leg must be on LEFT half. IT IS A STRIDE EXCHANGE, BOTH LEGS KEEP THEIR OWN COLORS.
Top-left straight spread contact, bright left foot leading.
Top-middle bright left leg supports under body, dark right foot swings.
Top-right bright left leg at back begins recovery, dark knee lifted LEFT.
Bottom-left reverse contact, bright RIGHT foot trailing and dark LEFT foot leading.
Bottom-middle dark left leg supports, bright RIGHT foot swinging behind.
Bottom-right dark left leg begins recovery and bright right knee lifts forward.
True orthographic profile at hip, no front-facing hips. Keep torso facing left and GPU consistent. NO labels or scenery. Background purely transparent alpha0, no glow or shadows. Style same cute hand-drawn illustration.
